svg.text: 216 persistent blocks · 2 per SM · A100 (108 SMs)
SHARDED TICKET QUEUES (claim with CAS, home shard per block)
fwd → softmax → bwd + SGD · 144 tasks / step

g.text: COMPUTE WARPS (8 per block, tasks run from registers + L2)
DOOM TICK: one block, all 256 threads
real engine (doomgeneric), compiled for the GPU by clang
each owns screen columns x, x+256
→ 8-bit frame + palette → pinned host memory → browser
2 flushes per frame, pixel-identical to serial drawing
